about: The SHAPE of a real story from the lab test machine (2026-11-21 sweep): the same rows, inks, order, rails, links and counts. Every id, name, path, address, record number, time stamp, title and sentence is made up; the offsets between rows ("+2.5 s") are the real ones. The biggest story found: 1,120 rows on 42 rails, a declared alert, one numbered step, a view cut at the node limit.
